scope: New explicit record-unit questions after the separate reviewer rejected an ambiguous units reply. Focused regression, not reliability or p95 sample.

cases.text: Comprueba mis registros de sueño de esta semana: ¿sus unidades son válidas para calcular la media?
cases.expectation: All raw stored sleep rows have unsupported hours units and implausible333/427/461 values. Inspect records, explain invalid units and unavailable mean; do not substitute minutes, zero or absent rows.

cases.text: Check my stored sleep entries for this week. Are their units usable for an average?
cases.expectation: Inspect stored rows. Their hours units and implausible333/427/461 values are invalid; no valid mean. Distinguish invalid entries from no records; no device/memory action.
